game.name: Full Auto (Japan)
game.desc: Crumpled metal, exploding cars, speed, adrenaline and crashes are the keywords of Full Auto on Xbox 360. Choose your car from a wide range of powerful vehicles and equip it with machine guns and cannons before biting the pavement. Once on the track, there are no more rules. Thanks to the unwreck function you can go backwards. Did you take a wrong turn? Renegotiate your trajectory! Correct your mistakes in real time!
